notes.title: Auto Battle: Galactic General 1.06 Update Plan
notes.content:
[h1] Version 1.06 Update[/h1]

[b][h2]The official version will differ from the beta, with new surprises awaiting you![/h2][/b]**
[h3]1. Addition of Two Hero-Specific Skills. Currently set to only deactivate upon flagship destruction.[/h3]**
1.1 Piloting: Allows heroes to control their flagship, shifting the gameplay mode to keyboard operation. The spaceship can move forward, backward, left, and right using WASD keys, with the spacebar for braking. Mouse direction determines the ship's orientation. Right-click to lock onto a target. Provides an action game experience.
1.2 Commanding: Allows heroes to control their fleet, transitioning the gameplay mode to RTS. Right-click to set a target or destination.
[h3]2. New Difficulty Levels Added.[/h3]**
Player feedback indicated the game was too challenging, so now players have four difficulty options. The current version's difficulty will be designated as Master, the highest difficulty level (where hero skills cannot be used). Lower difficulties offer more initial spaceships, equipment, and skill commands to reduce frustration.
[h3]3. Tutorial Videos Added.[/h3]**
Players found the game difficult to get started, so tutorial videos in both Chinese and English have been added, accessible from the menu. New players, watch out! Videos for the newly added hero-specific skills are not yet available.
[h3]4. Ship Fire Control Radar Display Added.[/h3]**
The combat interface now shows a fire control radar for ships when clicked with the left mouse button, either on the ship or its icon below, allowing players to adjust ship equipment based on radar performance.
[h3]5. Version Display Added to the Game Start Screen.[/h3]**
[h3]6. Soft Trigger Zones Added to Smooth Screen Movement.[/h3]**
[h3]Modifications:[/h3]**
The near-defense system's target selection has been changed to all enemies, with secondary weapons automatically attacking once enemies enter the primary weapon's attack radius.
The appearance of the flagship StarRiver has been revised.
The default target for commands and skill attacks has been modified to match.
Installation instruction arrows have been removed and replaced with tutorial videos.
[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]**
Fixed an issue with ship movement and steering.
Corrected several textual description errors.
Resolved an issue where failing LEVEL 22.1 and proceeding to LEVEL 23.1 prevented the storyline from continuing. Specifically, in Chapter 3's "Decisive Moment II". To avoid this bug before the new version, players must successfully complete LEVEL 21 or LEVEL 22.1.
Fixed a potential storyline continuation bug.
[h3]Contact Information on the STEAM Store Page[/h3]**

notes.title: 《Auto Battle: Galaxy General 》1.06 Test Event is About to Begin
notes.content:
[h1]   Auto Battle: Galaxy General 1.06 Test Version[/h1]
The duration and rounds of the test will vary based on feedback. The first test will invite hundreds of players.
The purpose of the test is to find bugs and obvious design flaws, and collect players' feelings and opinions. Please forgive me if the game has some shortcomings as it is still in its early stages.
[b]Note: The test version will have a console, which displays debug information about the game's operation.
Note: Save files from the test version will not be compatible with the official version.
New Features:[/b]

[h2]Added two unique hero skills. [/h2]
These skills can only be exited when the flagship is destroyed.
1.1 Piloting: Allows the hero to control their own flagship, transforming the game mode to keyboard operation. The ship can move forward, backward, left, and right using WASD, brake with the spacebar, and the mouse pointer determines the orientation. Right-click to lock onto a target, providing an action game experience.
1.2 Commanding: Allows the hero to control their own fleet, transforming the game mode into RTS. Right-click to set a target or location.


[h2]Added new difficulty options. [/h2]
Some players have reported that the game is too difficult, so now players have four difficulty levels to choose from. The current version's difficulty will be classified as Master, the highest difficulty level (hero skills cannot be used at this level). Lower difficulties will have more initial ships, equipment, and skill commands to reduce frustration.


[h2]Added tutorial videos. [/h2]
Due to feedback that the game is difficult to get started, tutorial videos in both Chinese and English have been added and can be viewed in the menu. New players must watch them! Videos for the new hero skills have not yet been added.


[h2]Added a display of ship fire control radar patterns. [/h2]
Now, when you left-click on a ship or its icon in the combat interface, you can see the ship's fire control radar, making it easier for players to adjust ship equipment based on radar performance.


[h2]Added a version display on the game's start screen.[/h2]


[h2]Added a soft trigger zone to make screen movement less abrupt and intense.[/h2]

[h2]Modifications:[/h2]
Changed the Closein Weapon System's target selection to all enemies. After an enemy enters the main weapon's attack radius, secondary weapons will automatically attack.
Modified the appearance of the flagship StarRiver.
Changed the Order  Target_Favorite  to match the skill AdaptationTarget.
Removed installation indication arrows and replaced them with instructional videos.

[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
Fixed an error in ship movement and steering.
Fixed several textual description errors.
Fixed a bug where failing LEVEL 22.1 and progressing to LEVEL 23.1 caused the storyline to stop. Specifically, in Chapter 3: Decisive Moment 2. Before the new version arrives, players must pass LEVEL 21 or LEVEL 22.1 with a victory to avoid encountering this bug.

Players outside China can provide feedback via email at zhannghong2002@aliyun.com. Players in China can join QQ group 1026688098 or provide feedback via email. More feedback methods and forms will be announced later.

[h2]Thank You[/h2]
Thank you to every player for your support! "Auto Battle: Galaxy General" is made perfect by your participation!
